title: Employer Billing Guide: The Monthly Program Invoice of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
Program charges under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement are billed monthly in arrears on an invoice issued on the tier's invoice issue business day of the following month, each line due the tier's invoice payment term, in calendar days, after its entry date. Each kind of invoice line is billed once per billing month and source. A line that comes to zero is not billed.

## Lines of the invoice

**Platform fee.** The platform fee line is the tier's monthly platform fee for every calendar month in which the agreement was live, suspended or terminating on any day, never prorated, reduced under the Payroll Card bundle terms when those apply.

**Per-worker fee (no longer in force).** The clause "Under the employer-paid fee model the per-worker fee line is the tier's per-worker monthly fee times the month's enrolled active workers on the census." is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

**Sponsored transfer fees.** Under the employer-sponsored model the sponsored instant fee line and the sponsored next-business-day fee line bill the tier's fee per sponsored instant transfer and per sponsored next-business-day transfer for each sponsored transfer of that speed booked in the month, a sponsored transfer being a transfer under the agreement's Access plans booked in the month that fell within the sponsored allowance of its pay period. The fee model in effect on a transfer's date decides which model bills it, so a month split by a fee model change bills each part under its own model.

**Additional payroll groups.** The additional payroll groups line bills the tier's monthly fee for each payroll group beyond the tier's included payroll groups.

**Implementation fee.** The implementation fee line of the tier's implementation fee is billed once on the invoice for the go-live month, unless the signed term in months is at least the tier's waiver term, in which case it is never billed.

**Early termination fee (no longer in force).** The clause "An early termination fee line is billed on the final invoice when the program terminates before the end of its current term: the tier's early termination fee months of the monthly platform fee, limited to the whole calendar months from the termination date to the renewal date; it is never billed at the end of a term for which notice was given in time." is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

**ACH return fee.** An ACH return fee line is billed for each returned ACH remittance, pointing to the return.

## Worked lines (hypothetical)

| Program | Facts of the month | Line billed |
|---|---|---|
| Enterprise tier, 11 payroll groups | 8 groups included, 50.00 for each further group | additional payroll groups: 3 groups at 50.00, that is 150.00 |
| Growth tier, 2 payroll groups | 2 groups included | no additional payroll groups line (it comes to zero) |
| Professional tier, 24-month term, go-live in the month | waiver term 36 months | implementation fee 2500.00 on this month's invoice |
| Professional tier, 36-month term | waiver term 36 months | no implementation fee line, ever |
| Enterprise tier, live from the 20th of the month | | full monthly platform fee of 1250.00, not prorated |

superseded_clauses: Under the employer_paid fee model the employer_paid_pepm line is employer_paid_pepm_usd times the month's enrolled_active_workers on the census.

An early_termination_fee line is billed on the final invoice when the program terminates before the end of its current term: early_termination_fee_months of the monthly platform fee, limited to program_msr_months_left_in_term months; it is never billed at the end of a term for which notice was given in time.
